summary: A Florida police officer was arrested after allegedly using Flock license-plate reader records 717 times to track his estranged wife's car with no law-enforcement purpose. The department then added audits, case-number requirements and annual training.
technical_summary: Flock's license-plate reader platform let an officer repeatedly search a specific vehicle by entering false or unrelated reasons. The department had no formal audits, so insider misuse of surveillance data went undetected for about two years.

technical_summary: Instagram's recommendation and feed systems exposed a vulnerable teenager to large amounts of suicide, self-harm and depressive content that she viewed and saved in the months before her death, with inadequate safeguards.

summary: Apple's iPhone dictation briefly showed the word 'Trump' when users said 'racist'. Apple confirmed a speech recognition issue and said a fix was coming.
technical_summary: A speech recognition model powering iOS dictation mis-transcribed 'racist' as 'Trump' due to reported phonetic overlap with words containing an 'r' consonant. Some speculated deliberate tampering; Apple attributed it to the model.

technology.quote: We are aware of an issue with the speech recognition model that powers dictation

failure_mode.quote: the issue boils down to phonetic overlap between “Trump” and “racist.”

notes: A former Siri employee suggested the substitution could be an internal prank; The Verge could not reproduce it.

summary: SafeRent's AI tenant-screening scores allegedly gave lower scores to Black and Hispanic applicants and those using housing vouchers, leading landlords to deny them housing. A class action ended in a roughly $2.3 million settlement and restrictions on the scores.
technical_summary: A scoring algorithm weighting credit history and non-rental debts produced SafeRent Scores used by landlords to accept or deny applicants. It ignored voucher income support and was non-transparent, yielding disparate impact on protected groups.

summary: A network of about 120 fake Facebook profiles with AI-generated photos reportedly shared posts by Bulgarian political party ITN and its leader, inflating their apparent engagement before elections.
technical_summary: Coordinated inauthentic accounts with AI-generated profile pictures, created in a similar pattern and with few friends, repeatedly reshared political posts, artificially amplifying reach. An AI-image detector confirmed the synthetic photos.
